blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Management Association of the Philippines (MAP) president Donald Lim has called on the government to ramp up efforts to modernize the country’s investment environment, saying efforts to promote the Philippines would be futile if rules are not at par with those in the rest of Southeast Asia.
